name: SuperTuxKart
summary: 3D kart racing game with story mode, online races and battle arenas.
description:
SuperTuxKart is an arcade kart racer starring Tux and friends. Race on over 20 tracks with power-ups, play the story mode, or go online and in split screen.

There are also battle, soccer and capture-the-flag modes, and an add-on browser for community karts and tracks.
